userStories.title: Solver — `apps/warewolf/lib/solver.ts` (DFS, throws on empty pool)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the pure-function solver — the math core of the entire app — that picks wolf compositions per archetype using DFS over the per-archetype wolf pool, satisfying singleton + pack-required + max-wolf-cub constraints, and emitting the closest-to-target balance.
acceptanceCriteria: File created at `apps/warewolf/lib/solver.ts` (pure module, no DOM/browser APIs; isomorphic).

Exports `communityWolfCount(n: number): number` returning the community-standard wolf count: 1@≤5, 2@6–9, 3@10–13, 4@14–20. (Note: prototype function is misleadingly named `bookletWolfCount`; rename to `communityWolfCount`.)

Exports `pickWolvesForBalance(archetypeId, count, targetSum)`: filters `WOLF_POOLS[archetypeId]` to remove `PACK_REQUIRED` roles when `count === 1`; DFS over filtered pool with replacement, respecting `SINGLETON_WOLVES` (max 1 each) and `MAX_WOLF_CUB = 2`; picks the composition minimizing `|sum − targetSum|`; THROWS on empty filtered pool per Eng Review decision #2 (replaces prototype's `return ['werewolf']` bug at `finalized.html:699`) with error message `Solver pool exhausted for ${archetypeId} (count=${count})`; deterministic — same args always return the same composition (no PRNG); returns array of length exactly `count`.

Exports `generateVariations(archetypeId, playerCount)`: `wolfCount = communityWolfCount(playerCount) + ARCHETYPES[archetypeId].wolfDelta`; for each of the 3 `VILLAGE_SEEDS[archetypeId]` entries: compute filler villagers, `targetWolfSum = -(villageSum + neutralSum + fillerSum)`, then `pickWolvesForBalance`; returns 3 Setup objects with `archetypeId`, `variationIdx`, `roman` (I/II/III), `roles[]` (length === playerCount), `balance` (sum of role.balance), `vibe` (from seed).

Exports `computeSetupList(playerCount, activeFilters?)`: filters `ARCHETYPES` to those with `minPlayers ≤ playerCount ≤ maxPlayers`; applies `activeFilters` if non-empty (otherwise show all valid); calls `generateVariations` per surviving archetype, CATCHES throws and substitutes a marker the UI renders as `<SolverErrorRow>` (US-014); returns flattened list sorted by `|balance|` ASCENDING.

Tests written: `apps/warewolf/lib/solver.test.ts` — `communityWolfCount` table (5,6,9,10,13,14,20 + boundary 4); `pickWolvesForBalance` count=1 filters PACK_REQUIRED, SINGLETON max=1, wolf-cub max=2, empty pool THROWS with expected message, deterministic, count=0 returns [] safely; `generateVariations` returns 3 entries with wolfDelta applied and roles.length === playerCount; `computeSetupList` hides archetypes outside range, filter narrows list, sorted by |balance| ASC; SOLVER PERF: `computeSetupList(20)` completes in < 50ms per Eng Review perf gate.
Typecheck passes: `cd apps/warewolf && bunx tsc --noEmit`.
Lint passes: `bun run lint`.

userStories.title: Validator — `apps/warewolf/lib/validator.ts` (single-pass, strict)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a pure-function validator that determines whether a setup is Playable, returning blocker codes, balance, and team sums for the Playable banner and balance scale to render.
acceptanceCriteria: File created at `apps/warewolf/lib/validator.ts`.

Exports `validate(setup: RoleId[], playerCount: number): { ok: boolean; blockers: BlockerCode[]; balance: number; wolfSum: number; villageSum: number; wolfCount: number; villageCount: number; neutralCount: number }`.

Blocker codes (union of string literals): `'no-wolves'` (wolf count === 0); `'wolves-gte-village'` (wolf count ≥ village count, neutrals EXCLUDED from parity check per Premise #3); `'role-count-mismatch'` (`setup.length !== playerCount`); `'unknown-role'` (any `RoleId` not in `ROLES`, STRICT per Eng Review decision #3).
Single-pass over `setup` per Eng Review code-quality fix (replaces prototype's three loops at `finalized.html:792–818`).
`ok` is `true` iff `blockers.length === 0`.
`balance`, `wolfSum`, `villageSum` computed in the same single pass.

Tests written: `apps/warewolf/lib/validator.test.ts` — no-wolves fires on all-village; wolves-gte-village fires (neutrals excluded); role-count-mismatch fires when length ≠ playerCount; unknown-role fires (validator MUST reject as type-contract guarantee per Eng Review decision #3, even though `decodeSetup` substitutes in production); all-OK happy path returns ok:true; fast-check property: random valid setup passes; fast-check property: random no-wolves setup returns no-wolves blocker.

userStories.title: Share URL — `apps/warewolf/lib/share-url.ts` (Zod, parser substitutes)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need encode/decode helpers for the share-URL format so any setup can round-trip through the URL as the single source of truth for shareable state.
acceptanceCriteria: File created at `apps/warewolf/lib/share-url.ts`.

Defines `ShareUrlSchema` (Zod): `z.object({ p: z.coerce.number().int().min(5).max(20).catch(8), roles: z.string().transform(csv => csv.split(',')).pipe(z.array(z.string())).transform(ids => ids.map(id => ROLES[id] ? id : 'villager')), lang: z.enum(['en','th']).default('en') })` per design doc Eng Review section.
Exports `encodeSetup({ playerCount, roles, lang }): URLSearchParams`.

Exports `decodeSetup(searchParams: URLSearchParams | string): { playerCount: number; roles: RoleId[]; lang: 'en' | 'th'; clampedP: boolean; substitutedIds: string[] }`. `clampedP` true when URL `p` was out-of-range. `substitutedIds` lists unknown role IDs silently replaced with `villager` per Eng Review decision #3.
Parser is the SINGLE source of unknown-id handling: unknown role IDs become `villager` silently. Validator never sees unknowns in production. Per Eng Review decision #3.
`decodeSetup` defaults: missing `p` → 8, missing `roles` → `['villager']`, missing `lang` → `'en'`.

Tests written: `apps/warewolf/lib/share-url.test.ts` — round-trip `decodeSetup(encodeSetup(x)).{playerCount,roles,lang}` === `x`; `p` out-of-range clamps and `clampedP===true`; unknown role id → `villager` and `substitutedIds` includes original; `roles=foo,bar` → `['villager','villager']`, `substitutedIds === ['foo','bar']`; URL length stays < 2048 chars at 20 players; missing params → defaults.
Typecheck passes: `cd apps/warewolf && bunx tsc --noEmit`.
Lint passes: `bun run lint`.

userStories.title: Balance audit property test (384 cells)
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need a property-style test that exercises every (archetype × playerCount × variationIdx) cell to guarantee the solver doesn't silently regress into unplayable rooms — the single most important regression net for V1.
acceptanceCriteria: Test added to `apps/warewolf/lib/solver.test.ts` (or new file `apps/warewolf/lib/solver-audit.test.ts`).

Property test using `fast-check` or a manual cartesian-product loop: for each archetypeId in ARCHETYPES, for each playerCount in [minPlayers..maxPlayers], for each variationIdx in [0,1,2], assert `|generateVariations(archetypeId, playerCount)[variationIdx].balance| ≤ 5` OR the cell is hidden by minPlayers/maxPlayers gating.
Cell count: 8 archetypes × (avg 13 player counts) × 3 variations = ~312 cells. (Spec doc cited up to 384 — that's the upper bound across all archetypes.)
Test fails loudly when any cell exceeds `|balance| > 5`, naming the offending `(archetype, playerCount, variationIdx)` tuple.
Test runs in < 5 seconds (acceptable for a CI gate).
Solver perf assertion (separate test in same file): `computeSetupList(20)` completes in < 50ms (per Eng Review perf gate).
Test runs on every PR via `bun run test`.
Typecheck passes: `cd apps/warewolf && bunx tsc --noEmit`.
Lint passes: `bun run lint`.
